selections.comment: GLORIOUSLY SASSY is taken to transfer his decent maiden form into a handicap here at the second time of asking having failed to do so on his penultimate start. The suspicion is that he has been let in lightly by the handicapper. The remainder have all been a bit up and down of late. Frankies Dream is worth considering because he had been in excellent form and would be favourite if there were any confidence he was still in the right mood. Unfortunately, he's been very headstrong early of late and may have become a bit temperamental. It is hard to split the remainder, perhaps Mysteryofthesands liking for soft ground just gives him the edge.

If brushing up on his jumping he can make amends at the expense of Belles Benefit who went too fast on her reappearance but is now just 1lb above her last winning mark. Another who has dropped in the weights is former course winner Mr Rumbalicious who bounced back to form here last time and is entitled to come on for the run. He will also provide a big challenge in an open race.

selections.comment: A tight contest where most of the field can be given a chance. Veteran hurdler HURRICANE ALI hasn't been in the best form of late but he has dropped a fair way in the weights and is relatively unexposed in this sphere. He found the race coming too soon on his last chase run but could bounce back now dropped to his optimum trip. Bareback Jack is a clear danger having gone very close on his chase debut finishing ahead of an in form rival. He is potentially thrown in on his old hurdle form but it is a concern that his stamina was giving way late last time over slightly shorter. Frustrating handicap hurdler Anyharminasking ran well on his chase debut despite conceding first run and can also make his presence felt.
